description: This file defines the 'GlobalConfigurationProperty' class, which maps to the 'c_configuration' database table in the Fineract project. It manages global configuration settings with properties such as name, enabled status, value types, and description. It includes methods for creating new instances and converting the entity to a data transfer object.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationProperty
classes.description: Entity class representing global configuration properties in the application, mapped to the 'c_configuration' table. It provides fields for various configuration attributes and methods to create instances and convert to data transfer objects.

methods.name: newSurveyConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a new GlobalConfigurationProperty instance with the specified name, used for survey configurations.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts this entity instance to a GlobalConfigurationPropertyData object for data transfer.
